description: This file contains integration tests for the 'Funds' feature in the Apache Fineract project. It tests creating, retrieving, updating, and error handling of funds via REST API endpoints, using JUnit 5 and RestAssured for HTTP requests and assertions.

classes.name: FundsIntegrationTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the Funds API endpoints, including create, retrieve, update, and error scenarios.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST Assured setup before each test, setting content type and authorization headers.

methods.name: testCreateFund
methods.description: Tests successful creation of a fund.

methods.name: testCreateFundWithEmptyName
methods.description: Tests fund creation with an empty name, expecting a 400 error.

methods.name: testCreateFundWithEmptyExternalId
methods.description: Tests fund creation with an empty external ID, expecting success.

methods.name: testCreateFundWithDuplicateName
methods.description: Tests creation of a fund with a duplicate name, expecting a 403 error.

methods.name: testCreateFundWithDuplicateExternalId
methods.description: Tests creation of a fund with a duplicate external ID, expecting a 403 error.

methods.name: testCreateFundWithInvalidName
methods.description: Tests fund creation with an invalid (too long) name, expecting a 400 error.

methods.name: testCreateFundWithInvalidExternalId
methods.description: Tests fund creation with an invalid external ID, expecting a 400 error.

methods.name: testRetrieveFund
methods.description: Retrieves a previously created fund and verifies its data.

methods.name: testRetrieveAllFunds
methods.description: Retrieves all funds and checks that at least one fund exists.

methods.name: testRetrieveUnknownFund
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a non-existent fund, expecting a 404 error.

methods.name: testUpdateFund
methods.description: Updates an existing fund and verifies the changes.

methods.name: testUpdateUnknownFund
methods.description: Attempts to update a non-existent fund, expecting a 404 error.

methods.name: testUpdateFundWithInvalidNewName
methods.description: Tries to update a fund with an invalid name, expecting a 400 error.

methods.name: testUpdateFundWithNewExternalId
methods.description: Updates the external ID of an existing fund.

methods.name: testUpdateFundWithInvalidNewExternalId
methods.description: Attempts to update a fund with an invalid external ID, expecting a 400 error.

methods.name: testUpdateFundWithNewName
methods.description: Updates the name of an existing fund.

methods.name: testUpdateFundWithEmptyParams
methods.description: Updates a fund with null parameters and verifies no change occurs.

methods.name: createFund
methods.description: Helper method to send a request to create a fund and return its ID or null if creation failed.
